scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n mock,api,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run mock:uw -w server" "cross-env UW_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4100 UW_API_KEY=00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
